snippet.title: NHL Puck Rush 🏒 Available Now
snippet.description:
Grab a biscuit and hit the ice—NHL Puck Rush is available today, exclusively on Playground with Play Pass. Jump in, select your team, and take your shots. The higher you score, the more exclusive NHL items you can unlock. Can you help your team climb the ranks?

Don’t miss out—subscribe for updates and exclusive gameplay previews.
